profile_text.body:
Character.AI, founded in 2022, describes itself as "the #1 AI chat app" where users can chat with millions of AI characters. The company positions its core product, Character.ai, as persona-based chat focused on interactive storytelling and roleplay experiences. Its tagline emphasizes user agency: "Your Words. Your World."

Character.ai operates in the Chat & General LLMs category. The platform's design centers on allowing users to create and interact with customized AI personalities rather than traditional single-model chatbots. The company's own documentation notes HR and appropriate-use considerations as relevant to its deployment context, suggesting awareness of workplace and safety implications in its positioning.
